extension.summary: Play a folder of mixed audio and video files as one playlist
extension.description: Plain folder view without library or scanning: the titles of the current folder on the left, the video of the running title on the right (empty for audio). Audio and video files play mixed in one queue, subfolders play at their list position. Per-folder sort (name, date, shuffle, custom order via move mode), seekable progress bar, fullscreen kept across titles. Made for TV remotes; mouse and touch work too.
